mapper.select:
SELECT m.id, i.category, i.sub_category AS subCategory, i.indicator_code AS indicatorCode, i.title, COALESCE(f.facility_name, '전체') AS facility, m.reporting_year AS year, CONCAT(CAST(m.reporting_year AS TEXT), '-', LPAD(CAST(m.period_value AS TEXT), 2, '0')) AS period, CAST(m.numerical_value AS NUMERIC) AS value,
/* 💡 [해결 핵심] DB 원본 스네이크 컬럼을 자바 DTO 카멜 필드에 1:1 결합 적재 */ m.period_type AS periodType, m.period_value AS periodValue, m.text_value AS textValue,
i.unit, m.data_source_type AS source, 'API/MANUAL' AS method, m.status, m.evidence_file_url AS evidence, CASE WHEN m.status = 'REJECTED' THEN '위험' ELSE '정상' END AS risk, m.reject_reason AS aiFinding, COALESCE(u.name, '시스템') AS assignee FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON m.indicator_id = i.id LEFT JOIN company_facilities f ON m.facility_id = f.id LEFT JOIN users u ON m.input_user_id = u.id
AND i.category = CAST(#{category} AS esg_category_enum)
AND m.reporting_year = #{year}
AND m.status = CAST(#{status} AS data_status_enum)
ORDER BY m.reporting_year DESC, m.period_value DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE esg_metric_data SET indicator_id = #{indicatorId}, facility_id = #{facilityId}, reporting_year = #{reportingYear}, period_type = CAST(#{periodType} AS period_type_enum), period_value = #{periodValue}, numerical_value = #{numericalValue}, text_value = #{textValue}, evidence_file_url = #{evidenceFileUrl}, status = CAST(#{status} AS data_status_enum), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO esg_metric_data ( company_id, facility_id, indicator_id, reporting_year, period_type, period_value, numerical_value, text_value, evidence_file_url, status, data_source_type, input_user_id ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{facilityId}, #{indicatorId}, #{reportingYear}, CAST(#{periodType} AS period_type_enum), #{periodValue}, #{numericalValue}, #{textValue}, #{evidenceFileUrl}, CAST(#{status} AS data_status_enum), #{dataSourceType}, #{inputUserId} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, category, sub_category AS subCategory, indicator_code AS indicatorCode, title, value_type AS valueType, unit FROM esg_indicators WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY category, indicator_code
mapper.update: UPDATE esg_metric_data SET status = CAST(#{status} AS data_status_enum), approver_user_id = #{approverId}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
